```{r}
cov_Z <- read.table(file.path(reports_path, "coverage", "mean_coverage_chrZ_per_sample.tsv"), header =T)

cov_auto <- read.table(file.path(reports_path, "coverage", "mean_coverage_per_sample.tsv"), header =T) 

coverage <- left_join(cov_auto, cov_Z, by="sample") %>%
filter(mean_chrZ_depth != "NA" & mean_autosomal_depth != "NA") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_chrZ_depth = as.numeric(mean_chrZ_depth),
    mean_autosomal_depth = as.numeric(mean_autosomal_depth),
    chrZ_to_autosome_ratio = mean_chrZ_depth / mean_autosomal_depth
  )

med_depth <- cov_auto %>%
  filter(mean_autosomal_depth > 2) %>%
  pull(mean_autosomal_depth) %>%
  mean() %>%
  round()

cov_autosomes <-
cov_auto %>%
  filter(mean_autosomal_depth > 2) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mean_autosomal_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "grey70",
    colour = "grey70"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = med_depth,
    linewidth = 1,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "maroon"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "\nMean autosomal depth",
    y = "Count"
  )

ggsave(cov_autosomes,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "figS2.png"),
      width=4,
      height=4)

```

```{r}
# Use k-means clustering to identify groups (try k=2 and k=3)
set.seed(123)

# Try k=2 (assuming 2 sexes)
kmeans_2 <- kmeans(coverage$chrZ_to_autosome_ratio, centers = 2, nstart = 25)
coverage$cluster_2 <- factor(kmeans_2$cluster)

# Try k=3 (in case there are 3 groups)
kmeans_3 <- kmeans(coverage$chrZ_to_autosome_ratio, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
coverage$cluster_3 <- factor(kmeans_3$cluster)

# Get cluster centers and assign sex based on ratio
# Lower ratio = Female (ZW), Higher ratio = Male (ZZ)
cluster_2_centers <- data.frame(
  cluster = as.factor(1:2),
  center = kmeans_2$centers[,1]
) %>%
  arrange(center) %>%
  mutate(sex = c("Female", "Male"))

cluster_3_centers <- data.frame(
  cluster = as.factor(1:3),
  center = kmeans_3$centers[,1]
) %>%
  arrange(center) %>%
  mutate(group = c("Group1_Low", "Group2_Mid", "Group3_High"))

# Assign sex for k=2
coverage <- coverage %>%
  left_join(cluster_2_centers %>% select(cluster, sex), 
            by = c("cluster_2" = "cluster"))

# Print cluster information
coverage %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(chrZ_to_autosome_ratio),
    sd_ratio = sd(chrZ_to_autosome_ratio),
    min_ratio = min(chrZ_to_autosome_ratio),
    max_ratio = max(chrZ_to_autosome_ratio)
  ) %>%
  print()

# Plot 1: Histogram with k=2 clustering
p1 <- ggplot(coverage, aes(x = chrZ_to_autosome_ratio, fill = sex)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  geom_vline(data = cluster_2_centers, aes(xintercept = center, color = sex),
             linetype = "dashed", size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF6B6B", "Male" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF6B6B", "Male" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex Determination Based on chrZ:Autosome Coverage Ratio (k=2)",
    subtitle = paste0("Female center: ", round(cluster_2_centers$center[1], 3), 
                     " | Male center: ", round(cluster_2_centers$center[2], 3)),
    x = "chrZ / Autosome Coverage Ratio",
    y = "Number of Samples",
    fill = "Predicted Sex",
    color = "Cluster Center"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40")
  )


# Plot 2: Density plot comparing k=2 and k=3
p2 <- ggplot(coverage, aes(x = chrZ_to_autosome_ratio)) +
  geom_density(fill = "gray", alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = cluster_2_centers, aes(xintercept = center),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(data = cluster_3_centers, aes(xintercept = center),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "blue", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.85, y = Inf, 
           label = "Red dashed: k=2\nBlue dotted: k=3", 
           vjust = 2, hjust = 0, color = "black", size = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Distribution with Cluster Centers",
    x = "chrZ / Autosome Coverage Ratio",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

# Plot 3: Scatter plot
p3 <- ggplot(coverage, aes(x = mean_autosomal_depth, y = mean_chrZ_depth, 
                           color = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Female" = "#FF6B6B", "Male" = "#4ECDC4")) +
  labs(
    title = "chrZ vs Autosomal Coverage",
    x = "Mean Autosomal Coverage",
    y = "Mean chrZ Coverage",
    color = "Predicted Sex (k=2)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
```

```{r}
coverage_renamed <- coverage %>%
    rename(IID=sample) %>%
    mutate(IID = sub("_dedup$", "", IID))

pca_Z <- read.table(file.path(reports_path, "pca", "chrZ.eigenvec"), header = T) %>% left_join(coverage_renamed, by="IID")

pca_chrZ <-
pca_Z %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, col=sex))+
    geom_point()+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("#d94b41", "#4f8ca8"))+
    theme_minimal(base_family = "roboto_condensed") +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),                      
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, family = "roboto_condensed"),
    axis.title = element_text(family = "roboto_condensed")
  ) + 
  labs(x="\nPC1", y="\nPC2", title="PCA on chrZ coloured by classification \n based on coverage")

ggsave(pca_chrZ,
      filename=file.path(figures_path, "pca_chrZ.png"),
      width=4,
      height=4)


pca_Z_subset <- pca_Z %>%
  mutate(assigned_sex = case_when(
    PC1 < -0.02 ~ "female",
    PC1 >  0.01 ~ "male",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

write.csv(pca_Z_subset, file.path(reports_path, "pca", "pca_Z.csv"))
```
